additional_info.subject: Re: ID0419853-DC/Si-D/IN-[Y2 / R4 312922184006]Default tag ID CRM:02698000041
additional_info.body:
Hello Neha,
Sicharge D do support the free mode, however there is no DefaultIDtag configured in it.
There is a Key “NonAuthorizedTag” which is Read/Write key, the value in this key is used during StartTransaction if the iutlet is cos-free. the default value empty.
You can refer the OCPP imlemnetation details here :
sicharge_d_software_manual_en-US_en-US.pdf - SICHARGE D Software Manual - ID: 109972034 - Industry Support Siemens
If an Integration support is required, it can be ordered. I have looped in my colleague Basheer & Sadek in this email.
I hope this answers your questions.
Let me know if you need further support, else we can close the case.
Thank you.
With best regards,
eMobility Tech Support Team -
Reetesh Sharma
